text_block_list.name: Head Priest
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san. Your shoulder, please.

I lean forward to give the head priest an 
easier angle at my shoulder. 
*WHACK!* The sharp crack of the keisaku 
echoed through the hall.

Some time had passed since we incorporated 
"mental discipline" 
into her training regimen, in preparation 
for the Oka Sho— 
and indeed, for the greater goals that lay 
beyond.
choice_data_list: （俺が声を出しても、動じてないな……）
（私が声を出しても、動じてないね……）
choice_data_list_en: (Even when I called out, she didn't seem fazed at all...)
(Even with me calling out, she didn't flinch at all...)

text_block_list.text: And as a result—
choice_data_list:
(Her focus during races has definitely 
sharpened.)

text_block_list.text:
Leading up to the Oka Sho, Phalaenopsis 
had a tendency 
to get overly fired up. It was something 
that surfaced 
especially during matched training 
gallops, but—
choice_data_list: （レースの際の集中力が、確実に上がった）
choice_data_list_en: (Her concentration during races has definitely improved.)

text_block_list.text:
As our training progressed, however... 
she became able to maintain the pace best 
suited to her.
choice_data_list: (It's really paying off...!)

text_block_list.text:
We moved to a different location for our 
next exercise. 
This was a trial we were attempting for 
the first time, 
out in the mid-December winter chill—
choice_data_list: （ちゃんと、成果が出てる……！）

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we step in? 
Into the dead-of-winter sea.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
I approved this because your vitals were 
clear, but don't 
stay in too long... Absolutely no more 
than five minutes. 
That goes for you too, Trainer! 
Understood?
choice_data_list: Y-Yes, ma'am... (t-t-teeth chattering)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Are you truly intent on taking this on 
as well? 
Unlike our other exercises, the physical 
toll is quite severe.
choice_data_list: は、はい……（ガチガチガチガチ）

text_block_list.text:
I wanted to grow mentally as a Trainer, 
too. 
That was what drove my offer. 
...I might be unreliable right now, but 
someday—
choice_data_list: でも、同じものを一緒にやるって決めたから
choice_data_list_en: Still, we decided we'd do the same routine together.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
If your resolve is set, I shall offer no 
coddling words. 
—Steel yourself, then.
choice_data_list: （君が頼れるトレーナーになりたいから）
（貴方が頼れるトレーナーになりたいから）
choice_data_list_en: (Because I want to be a Trainer you can count on.)
(Because I want to be a Trainer you can rely on.)

text_block_list.text:
I stripped down to my swimwear... The 
biting 
winter air pierced my skin. Before my 
spirit could waver, 
I hurriedly dipped my feet into the sea, 
and in that instant—
choice_data_list: (IT'S SO FREEEEEEZINGGG!!!)

text_block_list.text:
I splashed seawater all over my body. 
Empty the mind. Focus only on seeing this 
through.
choice_data_list: （つんんんんめったいっ！！！）

text_block_list.text:
Step by step I waded further, until the 
sea finally enveloped me. 
Amid the sharp pain and piercing chill, I 
fought to clear my thoughts!
choice_data_list:
(Ngh... I have to become someone worthy of 
her...!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: （くう……彼女に、相応しい自分に……！）
choice_data_list_en: (Ghh... I have to become someone worthy of her...!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Well returned. 
Admirable grit.
choice_data_list: B-Barely scraped by, though...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Now then, it is my turn.
choice_data_list: ぎ、ギリギリだったけどね……

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list:
S-She's marching right in without a 
word...

text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis waded steadily into the 
dead-of-winter sea. Having just 
experienced it myself, her incredible 
strength truly struck home.
choice_data_list: む、無言でずんずんと……

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (...Oh? This is... I see.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(The harsher the physical strain... 
the better the opportunity to commune with 
one's spirit, is it?)

Even before, she likely could have endured 
it. 
Yet the Phalaenopsis of now went beyond 
that— 
she had mastered the fortitude to weather 
it with ease.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
choice_data_list: Great work! Let me get you a towel—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, delightfully refreshing. 
Quite optimal for a cold dip.
choice_data_list: お疲れ様！今タオルを――
choice_data_list_en: Good work! Let me get you a towel—

text_block_list.text:
Having completed today's mental discipline 
routine, we returned 
to the academy. I shared what I had 
learned with her.
choice_data_list:
Winter swimming really feels like it 
builds mental toughness.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Placing oneself in so punishing an 
environment 
compels a state of profound focus. 
—Truly, a rigorous and worthwhile 
endeavor.
choice_data_list: 寒中水泳は精神的にかなり鍛えられそうだね
choice_data_list_en: Midwinter swimming sounds like it'd really forge mental toughness.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It is a discipline well worth continuing 
until winter's end. 
Incorporate it into our routine.
choice_data_list:
Got it! Next time, I'll see it through 
flawlessly too.

Right! Next time, I'll see it through 
flawlessly too, you'll see.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Heh, I admire that spirit.
choice_data_list: ああ！次こそ、俺も完璧にこなしてみせる
うん！次こそ、私も完璧にこなしてみせるよ
choice_data_list_en: Yeah! Next time, I'll pull it off perfectly too.
Yeah! Next time, I'll pull it off flawlessly too.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Keep warm and rest well tonight.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really?! I was wondering why 
I hadn't seen you on the track lately...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea! You've been doing mental 
conditioning together with your Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. ...Though it would have sufficed 
for me alone, 
that one has been tackling it with 
single-minded devotion.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Special Week. A classmate of mine setting 
her sights on the 
Classic Triple Crown. Cheerful, lively, 
and undeniably skilled— 
she is the bloom drawing all eyes in our 
generation.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... One could call it a strong sense of 
duty, 
or perhaps foolishly earnest.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A sincere Trainer, through and through. 
It is one of that person's finer virtues.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, so that's why! That's why you've 
been 
giving it your all so much lately, 
Phaleno-san!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? My efforts? 
I believe we were speaking of my Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I thought that's what we were talking 
about... 
Was it not? Because, I mean—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When the person supporting you works that 
hard right alongside you, 
doesn't it make you want to try even 
harder?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Perhaps seeing my Trainer strive with 
such single-minded devotion 
stirred something within my heart.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I see... 
By having my Trainer by my side...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...I was able to push myself all the 
more.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Hahaha.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What is it, Phalaeno-san? 
Laughing out of nowhere like that.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No, 'tis nothing... Nothing of 
consequence.

Phalaenopsis continues her training 
session after session. 
The Oka Sho she has set her sights on 
draws ever near.
